## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: rules of the road, part two
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The painted-curb colors are shown only in a picture whose color labels extracted apart from the rules; the three curb rules are taught without assigning colors (verify TN-ROADTWO-D-CURB) [A11].
The turn, passing and parking diagrams were not used; only the step text beside them was taught.
The chapter's sample questions are review aids, and their answers sit in the back of the manual outside the selected pages, so no sample answer is taught as a fact [A12].
U-turn bans, reserved lane hours and meter rules can be set locally, so the state-level rules are taught and local variation is flagged as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 80 lists three painted-curb rules (passenger stop only, loading only, no stopping) while the curb colors appear only as picture labels; confirm which color carries which rule from an official source before teaching colors.
